doc: What -importsaves brings over from an original game installed on this computer (platform/SaveImport.cpp, which has this table compiled in). Nothing outside this table is ever taken. A value or file pattern matches without regard to case; '*' stands for any characters inside one path part, '#' for digits. Registry value paths are relative to the game's key and use backslashes; file paths use slashes and are relative to the folder that holds the saves.

hives.vs: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\VirtualStore\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\<WOW6432Node\><key>: where Windows redirects the writes of a game that was not run as administrator
hives.hklm: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\<WOW6432Node\><key>: the 32-bit view that a 32-bit original uses
